text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was holding a meeting with Mejiro Bright—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my~ Little birds, bunnies,
and even squirrels♪ Ufufu—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, where could all the animals
have gone~?
The forest concert is about to start soon, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems that you haven't brought
your assigned tambourine either, Trainer-sama..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright, who still seems unable to tell dream from reality,
appears to be suffering from a lack of sleep...
